title: Stage-all-on-connect stages onto the download Pod, whose disk is hard-capped at 20 GB and has no ComfyUI
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-467 (the 1.4 smoke umbrella) - surfaced by its GPU smoke matrix, listed in tasks/MPI-467/brief.md.

Observed live during the MPI-467 GPU smoke matrix, 2026-08-08, with 'Stage all models on connect' ON. Pod oqtdy2y0kkybve, wrapper 0.2.43, EU-RO-1, volume aghcuvg7nl.

THE DEFECT IS ONE THING: the app runs its connect-time staging against a DOWNLOAD-MODE Pod. The Pod's own log says '[cubric] DOWNLOAD MODE - wrapper only, no ComfyUI (no GPU bill)' and 'ComfyManager disabled (download mode / no GPU) - wrapper runs ComfyUI-less', and the app still emitted 'Warming the cloud engine - staging 14 models to fast disk'. There is no ComfyUI on that host to serve a staged weight to, so every byte copied is discarded when the Pod is deleted minutes later - and it competes for disk with the installs that are the only reason that Pod exists.

IT CANNOT EVEN PARTIALLY SUCCEED THERE, AND NOT FOR A FIXABLE REASON. A download Pod gets CONTAINER_DISK_CPU_GB = 20 (routes/remotePodLifecycle.js:280) because RunPod REJECTS a CPU Pod with more ('Container Disk must be <= 20'). 20 GB holds about one model. Three consecutive log lines are the whole outcome:
    hot-store: staged 'diffusion_models/Chroma1-HD-DanrisiMix-Hyper-Flash-Turbo-int8-convrot-simple.safetensors' to disk (9201358732 bytes)
    hot-store: evicted LRU 'diffusion_models/Chroma1-HD-DanrisiMix-Hyper-Flash-Turbo-int8-convrot-simple.safetensors' to make room
    hot-store: not enough disk for 'text_encoders/t5xxl_fp16.safetensors' (9787841024 needed, 12232814592 free) - serving from volume
Staged 9.2 GB, evicted that same file for the next, then could not fit the next either. Sizing the Pod up is NOT the answer here - RunPod forbids it on CPU Pods.

WHAT IS NOT BROKEN - DO NOT 'FIX' IT: on a GPU Pod, MPI-329 ALREADY sizes container disk to mirror the network volume (_volumeMatchedDiskGb -> volume size + 5 GB headroom, clamped 100-600; :702 and :710 select it whenever !noGpu && volumeId). For volume aghcuvg7nl that is 455 GB against a 325 GB staged set, so eviction never fires and staging is exactly the ~80s->9s model-switch win it was built for. Staging is also NOT skippable by turning the setting off: with stage-all off, models stage on FIRST USE instead, so a run that touches every model stages the same bytes either way. The setting only chooses eager vs lazy.

THE FIX IS THEREFORE NARROW: do not stage in download mode. No ComfyUI = no consumer, and the disk is capped where the set cannot fit. Everything else about the feature is correct as designed.

WHERE TO LOOK: the connect path that emits 'Warming the cloud engine - staging N models to fast disk' (renderer -> POST /remote/hot-store/ensure, routes/remoteProxyForward.js:283) - it needs the same noGpu/download-mode test the Pod create path already has.

HISTORY NOTE: this card first claimed a second defect - that stage-all thrashes whenever the set exceeds container disk. That was wrong, written before reading MPI-329. The GPU path sizes the disk from the volume precisely so it cannot happen. The 20 GB disk in the evidence above is the CPU download Pod's hard cap, not the general case.

THIRD PIECE OF EVIDENCE, same run, app side: at 18:14:41Z the app logged a burst of '[WARN] [commandExecutor] hot-store ensure HTTP 404 - generating from volume' against the download Pod. So the app is not merely staging pointlessly there - it is calling a route the download-mode wrapper does not even serve, and eating a 404 per file. It degrades correctly (warn + generate from volume), which is why nobody noticed. The noGpu test belongs BEFORE the call, not in its error handler.
